description: Residual-stream patch windows for the matched-S2 intervention, per model. The window is the set of transformer layers at whose `hook_resid_post` the S2 state is replaced with the matched control's state. Windows are middle-layer bands scaled to each model's depth, defined in the producing analysis scripts and reproduced in the paper (Section 3 and Appendix E).
metric: logit difference between the correct (indirect-object) name and the repeated (subject) name at the final position

provenance.note: Windows are encoded in the analysis scripts that produced the released result files. The commit hashes below identify the internal analysis repositories; the released numbers are committed under data/ and checked by scripts/verify_claims.py.
